title: NBN POI 2MYF (Mayfield) - Permanent cable repair
current_summary: Scheduled maintenance affecting NBN services via the Mayfield (2MYF) POI has been completed. All work was finished by 7:00 AM AEST on Monday 7 September 2026, and services are now operating as normal.

updates.content: We will be carrying out scheduled maintenance with an upstream network partner between 12:00 AM and 7:00 AM AEST on Monday 7 September 2026. This is to complete a permanent cable repair. NBN services delivered via the Mayfield (POI 2MYF) Point of Interconnect may experience interruptions during this window, for up to 6 hours in total. Our team will monitor the works and update this notice if anything changes. We appreciate your patience.

Scheduled maintenance for NBN services at the Mayfield (2MYF) POI has now commenced. The maintenance window remains between 12:00 AM and 7:00 AM AEST on Monday 7 September 2026. Services may experience interruptions during this period. We will provide further updates as the works progress.
Scheduled maintenance at the Mayfield (2MYF) POI has been completed. All work finished by 7:00 AM AEST on Monday 7 September 2026, and services are now operating as normal.
